defined: WP-12 Phase 4c (spec 4.6), 2026-10-31, before any run of these profiles. A change is a new version.
scope: Interpretable TLMPM parameter sets for the opt-in rcs_scene_v1 workpiece.material_profile. Every profile is a single- or two-factor variation of wp12_reference_v1 (= the frozen cutting_tasks_v1 recipe) so a behaviour difference can be traced to one parameter. No value is measured on a real material; the names describe the intended qualitative regime only.

solver_mapping.yield_stress_pa: TLMPMConfig.yield_stress (perfect J2 return mapping; hardening is not supported by the retained cutting law and is fixed to 0)
solver_mapping.friction: TLMPMConfig.contact_friction: Coulomb coefficient of BOTH blade-material and board(fixture)-material contact in TLMPM
solver_mapping.fracture_energy_j_m2: TLMPMConfig.cutting_energy G_c: law-8 edge-work separation threshold G_c * V^(2/3) * (1 - sharpness) / sharpness per particle (cutting resistance)

stability_rule.quantity: longitudinal elastic wave speed c = sqrt((lambda + 2 mu) / rho); grid CFL = dt * c / grid_dx
stability_rule.admit_if: grid CFL <= 0.2 on the scene grid (4 mm) at the requested material dt (same rule as food_profiles_v1.numerical_selection)
stability_rule.particle_spacing_cfl: dt * c / particle_spacing (1 mm) is reported only: TLMPM integrates on the grid, and the frozen reference recipe itself has 0.67 at 1 mm / 0.1 ms
stability_rule.material_dt_s: largest declared dt of the profile (a run may use a smaller dt; a larger one is refused)

wp12_reference_v1.interpretation: Control: the frozen cutting_tasks_v1 provisional Plasticine-like recipe, unchanged.

wp12_soft_elastic_v1.interpretation: Soft elastic: E 2.5x lower and yield effectively disabled (1 MPa), so deformation is recoverable and larger under the same load.

wp12_clay_plastic_v1.interpretation: Clay-like plastic: same E, yield 2.5x lower (400 Pa, self-weight stress rho g H of a 16 mm bar is 235 Pa), so the blade leaves permanent plastic flow.

wp12_firm_v1.interpretation: Firmer deformable, the stiffest admissible at 0.1 ms: E 1.4x (70 kPa) and yield 3x (3 kPa); grid CFL 0.198.

wp12_stiff_v1.interpretation: Stiffer deformable: E 3x (150 kPa), yield 5x (5 kPa). Grid CFL 0.29 at 0.1 ms is REFUSED; admitted at 50 us (0.145).

wp12_low_friction_v1.interpretation: Slippery surface (wet / oily): Coulomb 0.05 against blade and board.

wp12_high_friction_v1.interpretation: Sticky / grippy surface: Coulomb 0.8 against blade and board.

wp12_low_cut_resistance_v1.interpretation: Easy to cut: law-8 cutting energy G_c 5x lower (0.01 J/m^2).

wp12_high_cut_resistance_v1.interpretation: Hard to cut (tough): law-8 cutting energy G_c 10x higher (0.5 J/m^2).

wp12_light_v1.interpretation: Light (foam-like density): rho 1100 kg/m^3; grid CFL 0.196 at 0.1 ms.

limitations: Isotropic perfect J2 plasticity only: no hardening, viscosity, rate or temperature dependence, anisotropy or damage
One friction coefficient for blade and board contact
Cutting resistance is the law-8 edge-work threshold, not a measured fracture toughness
No profile is calibrated against a measurement
